image_description: A group of sea lions resting on wooden docks. The central subject is a brown sea lion sitting upright, facing forward with its head tilted up. To the left, another sea lion lies on its back. In the background and foreground right, parts of other sea lions are visible. The setting appears to be a sunny pier or floating dock.

Despite the pose, the general mass of the animal appears symmetrically balanced.
